items.title: Leware Construction Company claimed by Storm-1567
items.summary: Tracker listing shows a US construction firm claimed by Storm-1567 with an attack date of Nov 11, 2026; no public confirmation from the victim yet.

items.title: Nota Groep listed on Inc Ransom leak site
items.summary: Transportation-sector company Nota Groep was listed as an Inc Ransom victim, discovered Nov 10, 2026.

items.title: Advantage Archives listed by Inc Ransom
items.summary: Records-management firm Advantage Archives appeared on Inc Ransom's leak site in November 2026, a third-party data-exposure risk for its clients.

items.title: Everest posts 'final notice before publication' claim
items.summary: Everest posted an unnamed victim with a final-notice countdown on Nov 13, 2026, signalling imminent data publication.

items.title: n0n group posts multiple unnamed US victims
items.summary: The n0n group listed several unnamed victims, including a US company, around Nov 9, 2026.

items.title: BlackFog: State of Ransomware 2026
items.summary: BlackFog's running 2026 report, updated Nov 5, tracks publicly disclosed and unreported attacks by sector and group.

ransomware.note: Named victims in today's search came only from leak-site trackers (Nov 9–13); verify before acting on any single listing.

items.title: Nov 12–17 outage cluster: Microsoft 365, AWS, Workday, FAA
items.summary: TechRepublic's November timeline records a week of disruptions across Microsoft 365, AWS, Workday and the FAA air traffic network, plus JPMorgan Chase, United Airlines and Apple.

items.title: FAA air traffic network overload
items.summary: The FAA's air traffic network suffered a major outage in mid-November; the preliminary cause given is a network overload.

items.title: Google Cloud europe-west2-b utility power loss (London)
items.summary: A third-party facility hosting the europe-west2-b zone lost utility power on Oct 20, 2026, affecting workloads in that zone.

outage.note: No confirmed new hyperscaler outage in the last 24h; latest items are from Nov 12–17.

items.title: CISA: Node2Shell flaw now actively exploited
items.summary: CISA warns that attackers are exploiting the critical Node2Shell (Brotli) remote code execution flaw and has added it to the KEV catalog.

items.title: Six KEV adds incl. Chrome zero-day and Barracuda ESG RCE
items.summary: On Nov 10 CISA added six exploited flaws spanning Outlook, Chrome, Barracuda, Cisco BroadWorks and Openwave Webtop, with an unusually short three-day deadline for the Barracuda bugs.

items.title: Four KEV adds: GPUStack, FreeSWITCH, OpenSSH, Aspera Faspex
items.summary: CISA's Nov 9 additions set a Nov 12 deadline; GPUStack admins are told to check for malicious backends and rotate credentials.

items.title: Ivanti Connect Secure zero-day chain extended
items.summary: Further CVEs were added to the Ivanti Connect Secure chain that began in October, with a Nov 13 KEV deadline and a call for forensic triage.

items.title: M 6.8 — 105 km NE of Lospalos, Timor Leste
items.summary: Nov 21 quake, no tsunami, USGS PAGER green.

items.title: M 6.7 — 7 km ENE of Carhuamayo, Peru
items.summary: Nov 21 quake in central Peru, tsunami flag set, PAGER green.

items.title: M 6.5 — Vanuatu region
items.summary: Nov 23 quake, tsunami flag set, PAGER green.

items.title: M 6.4 — Mauritius–Réunion region
items.summary: Nov 24 quake, no tsunami, PAGER green.

items.title: M 5.9 — 238 km SW of Yanglong, China
items.summary: Nov 21 quake in western China, PAGER yellow, which means some impact is likely.

items.title: Cyclone Murasu landfall, Andhra Pradesh
items.summary: Cyclone Murasu came ashore on the Andhra Pradesh coast on Nov 3, the second cyclone landfall there in under a week.

items.title: Ecuador floods: 12 dead, 56,000+ affected
items.summary: PAHO reports heavy rain and flooding across Ecuador killed 12 people and affected 56,323.

items.title: Santa Catarina, Brazil: 671 storm incidents
items.summary: Santa Catarina reported 671 storm-related incidents across 76 municipalities on Nov 4–5.

items.title: Weekly disaster roundup (Nov 17)
items.summary: CDP's weekly update tracks active US and global disasters and recovery funding needs.

physical.note: Earthquakes are from the USGS feed for this week; the weather items are from early to mid November, and no wildfire events turned up this month.
